manifestations.invariant: When one declaration line cannot be classified, its heading assessment is unwound before bonded clearance, and a corrected resubmission is assessed exactly once.

contract_bindings.quote: The duty assessor consolidates each heading into a declaration assessment.

A bonded release may clear only after every declared line has a confirmed
classification.
